    /* Suppliers Carousel */
    .suppliers-carousel {
        overflow: hidden;
        width: 100%;
        background: transparent;
        max-width: 100% !important;
    }

    .suppliers-carousel__track {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 60px;
        width: max-content;
        will-change: transform;
    }

    .suppliers-carousel__track.is-animated {
        animation: suppliers-scroll var(--scroll-duration, 30s) linear infinite;
    }

    .suppliers-carousel:hover .suppliers-carousel__track {
        animation-play-state: paused;
    }

    @keyframes suppliers-scroll {
        0% {
            transform: translateX(0);
        }
        100% {
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }
    }

    .suppliers-carousel__item {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 200px;
        height: 100px;
    }

    .suppliers-carousel__item img {
        max-width: 100%;
        max-height: 100%;
        width: auto;
        height: auto;
        object-fit: contain;
    }

    .suppliers-carousel__link {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
    }

    .suppliers-carousel__link:hover {
        opacity: 0.7;
    }

    /* Mobile */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .suppliers-carousel__track {
            gap: 40px;
        }

        .suppliers-carousel__item {
            width: 100px;
            height: 50px;
        }
    }
    

    /* RESET: Hide all p and br injected by WordPress */
    .sectors-grid p,
    .sectors-grid br,
    .sectors-grid > p,
    .sector-card p,
    .sector-card br,
    .sector-card > p,
    .sector-card__header p,
    .sector-card__header > p,
    .sector-card__content p,
    .sector-card__content > p,
    .sector-card__services p,
    .sector-card__services li p,
    .sector-card--emergency p,
    p:has(> .sector-card__all-link),
    p:has(> .sector-card__emergency-link),
    p:has(> button.sector-card__header),
    p:has(> span.sector-card__icon),
    p:has(> span.sector-card__title),
    p:has(> span.sector-card__toggle) {
        display: contents !important;
        margin: 0 !important;
        padding: 0 !important;
    }

    .sectors-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:1.2rem}
    .sector-card{background-color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-1);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0px 0px 6px 0px #00000025;overflow:visible;display:flex;flex-direction:column;margin-top:40px}
    .sector-card__header{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:24px 20px 16px;background:none;border:none;cursor:default;width:100%;text-align:center}
    .sector-card__icon{width:80px;height:80px;background-color:var(--wp--preset--color--base);border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0px 4px 10px 0px #00000040;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:16px;margin-top:-68px}
    .sector-card__icon .dashicons{font-size:35px;width:35px;height:35px;color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-1)}
    .sector-card__icon img{width:35px;height:35px;object-fit:contain}
    .sector-card__title{color:var(--wp--preset--color--base);font-size:var(--wp--preset--font-size--medium);font-weight:700;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.5px;font-family:var(--wp--preset--font-family--jost)}
    .sector-card__toggle{display:none}
    .sector-card__content{padding:0 20px 24px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
    .sector-card__content-inner{display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
    .sector-card__services{list-style:none;margin:0 0 12px 0;padding:0;flex:1}
    .sector-card__services li{margin-bottom:10px}
    .sector-card__services li:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
    .sector-card__services a{display:block;background-color:var(--wp--preset--color--base);color:var(--wp--preset--color--contrast);text-decoration:none;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0px 0px 5px 0px #00000010;font-size:var(--wp--preset--font-size--small);font-weight:400;text-align:center;transition:transform 0.2s ease,box-shadow 0.2s ease}
    .sector-card__services a:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0px 2px 8px 0px #00000020}
    .sector-card__all-link{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;background-color:var(--wp--preset--color--base);color:var(--wp--preset--color--contrast);text-decoration:none;padding:12px 16px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0px 0px 5px 0px #00000010;font-size:var(--wp--preset--font-size--small);font-weight:400;text-align:center;margin-top:auto;transition:transform 0.2s ease,box-shadow 0.2s ease}
    .sector-card__all-link:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0px 2px 8px 0px #00000020}
    .sector-card__all-link svg{flex-shrink:0}
    .sector-card--emergency{background-color:var(--wp--preset--color--base);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:32px 24px}
    .sector-card__emergency-content{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center}
    .sector-card__emergency-title{font-size:var(--wp--preset--font-size--xx-large);font-weight:700;color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-1);line-height:1}
    .sector-card__emergency-subtitle{font-size:var(--wp--preset--font-size--medium);font-weight:700;color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-1);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:12px}
    .sector-card__emergency-text{display:block;color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-1);font-size:var(--wp--preset--font-size--small);margin:0 0 20px}
    .sector-card__emergency-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background-color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-1);color:var(--wp--preset--color--base);text-decoration:none;padding:14px 28px;border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0px 0px 5px 0px #00000010;font-size:var(--wp--preset--font-size--small);font-weight:600;transition:transform 0.2s ease,box-shadow 0.2s ease}
    .sector-card__emergency-link:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0px 4px 12px 0px #00000030}
    .sector-card__emergency-link svg{flex-shrink:0}
	.sector-card__emergency-link.orange-btn{background-color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-2);margin: 10px 0 0;}
    @media(max-width:1024px){.sectors-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
    @media(max-width:768px){
        .sectors-grid{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0}
        .sector-card:not(.sector-card--emergency){background-color:var(--wp--preset--color--base);border-radius:0;box-shadow:none;border-bottom:1px solid #535e6452;margin-top:0}
        .sector-card:not(.sector-card--emergency):not(:has(+ .sector-card:not(.sector-card--emergency))){border-bottom:none}
        .sector-card__header{flex-direction:row;padding:16px 10px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;align-items:center}
        .sector-card__icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:8px;margin-bottom:0;margin-right:14px;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:none;background-color:transparent;margin-top:0}
        .sector-card__icon .dashicons{font-size:28px;width:28px;height:28px;color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-1)}
        .sector-card__icon img{width:28px;height:28px}
        .sector-card__title{flex:1;font-size:var(--wp--preset--font-size--small);color:var(--wp--preset--color--contrast)}
        .sector-card__toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:28px;height:28px;flex-shrink:0;color:var(--wp--preset--color--accent-1);transition:transform 0.3s ease}
        .sector-card__header[aria-expanded="true"] .sector-card__toggle{transform:rotate(90deg)}
        .sector-card__content{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;padding:0 20px;transition:max-height 0.4s ease,padding 0.4s ease;display:block}
        .sector-card__content.is-open{max-height:500px;padding:0 20px 20px}
        .sector-card__content-inner{padding-top:8px}
        .sector-card--emergency{padding:28px 20px;background-color:var(--wp--preset--color--base);border-bottom:none;margin-top:var(--wp--preset--spacing--40)}
		.sector-card__content a{box-shadow:0px 4px 10px 0px #00000035}
    }

(function() {
        function initSuppliersCarousel() {
            var carousels = document.querySelectorAll(".suppliers-carousel");
            
            carousels.forEach(function(carousel) {
                var track = carousel.querySelector(".suppliers-carousel__track");
                var items = track.querySelectorAll(".suppliers-carousel__item");
                var speed = parseInt(carousel.dataset.speed) || 50; // píxeles por segundo
                
                if (items.length === 0) return;
                
                // Ensure enough items to fill viewport
                function ensureEnoughItems() {
                    var trackWidth = track.scrollWidth / 2;
                    var viewportWidth = carousel.offsetWidth;
                    
                    if (trackWidth < viewportWidth * 2) {
                        var originalHTML = track.innerHTML;
                        var duplicatesNeeded = Math.ceil((viewportWidth * 2) / trackWidth);
                        
                        for (var i = 0; i < duplicatesNeeded; i++) {
                            track.innerHTML += originalHTML;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                // Calculate and set animation duration based on track width
                function setAnimationSpeed() {
                    var halfTrackWidth = track.scrollWidth / 2;
                    var duration = halfTrackWidth / speed;
                    track.style.setProperty("--scroll-duration", duration + "s");
                    
                    // Restart animation
                    track.classList.remove("is-animated");
                    void track.offsetWidth; // Force reflow
                    track.classList.add("is-animated");
                }
                
                // Initialize
                ensureEnoughItems();
                setAnimationSpeed();
                
                // Recalculate on resize
                var resizeTimeout;
                window.addEventListener("resize", function() {
                    clearTimeout(resizeTimeout);
                    resizeTimeout = setTimeout(function() {
                        setAnimationSpeed();
                    }, 200);
                });
            });
        }

        // Init on DOM ready
        if (document.readyState === "loading") {
            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", initSuppliersCarousel);
        } else {
            initSuppliersCarousel();
        }
    })();

   0) Contenedor general
   ========================================================= */

.rplg{
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column-reverse;
  padding-top: 45px;
}


/* =========================================================
   1) Header controls (solo flechas)
   ========================================================= */

.rplg .cb-reviews-head{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:flex-end;
  align-items:center;
  gap:12px;
  margin:0;
}

.rplg .cb-reviews-controls{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
}

.rplg .cb-arrow{
  width:25px;
  height:25px;
  background: transparent;
  border-radius:999px;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  cursor:pointer;
  user-select:none;
  -webkit-user-select:none;
  transition:box-shadow .2s ease, transform .2s ease, opacity .2s ease;
}

.rplg .cb-arrow:active{
  transform:translateY(1px);
}

.rplg .cb-arrow[disabled]{
  opacity:.45;
  cursor:not-allowed;
  box-shadow:none;
}

.rplg .cb-arrow svg{
  width:25px;
  height:25px;
  fill:#ED7D00;
  display:block;
}


/* =========================================================
   2) Slider track
   ========================================================= */

.rplg .rplg-reviews{
  display:flex !important;
  flex-wrap:nowrap !important;
  gap:28px;
  overflow-x:auto;
  overflow-y:hidden;
  scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;
  scroll-behavior:smooth;

  padding:10px 16px ;
  scroll-padding-left:16px;
  scroll-padding-right:40px;

  /* ocultar scrollbar */
  scrollbar-width:none;      /* Firefox */
  -ms-overflow-style:none;   /* IE/Edge legacy */

  /* evitar selección accidental */
  user-select:none;
  -webkit-user-select:none;
  -webkit-touch-callout:none;

  /* mejora experiencia drag */
  cursor:grab;
}

.rplg .rplg-reviews::-webkit-scrollbar{
  display:none; /* Chrome/Safari/Edge */
}

.rplg .rplg-reviews.is-dragging{
  cursor:grabbing;
  scroll-snap-type:none;
}

/* el track vacío del plugin */
.rplg .rplg-reviews > span:only-child{
  display:none !important;
}


/* =========================================================
   3) Items
   ========================================================= */

.rplg .rplg-reviews > .rplg-review{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  width:calc(66.666% - 10px);
  scroll-snap-align:start;
  scroll-snap-stop:always;
}

/* evitar selección de texto e imágenes dentro del slide */
.rplg .rplg-review,
.rplg .rplg-review *{
  user-select:none;
  -webkit-user-select:none;
}

.rplg .rplg-review img,
.rplg .rplg-review svg{
  pointer-events:none;
  -webkit-user-drag:none;
  user-drag:none;
}


/* =========================================================
   4) Review card style
   ========================================================= */

.rplg .cb-review-card{
  background:#fff;
  border-radius:14px;
  box-shadow:0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
  padding:22px 24px;
  margin:0;
  min-height:100%;
}

.rplg .cb-review-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:14px;
}

.rplg .cb-review-avatar{
  width:54px;
  height:54px;
  flex:0 0 54px;
  border-radius:999px;
  overflow:hidden;
}

.rplg .cb-review-avatar img{
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;
  display:block;
}

.rplg .cb-review-meta{
  min-width:0;
  flex:1;
}

.rplg .cb-review-name{
  font-weight:700 !important;
  font-size:16px;
  line-height:1.15;
  color:#14a3eb;
}

.rplg .cb-review-sub{
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:10px;
  margin-top:4px;
  color:#7a8796;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height: 1.2em !important;
}

.rplg .cb-review-provider svg,
.rplg .cb-review-provider img{
  width:18px;
  height:18px;
  display:block;
  opacity:.9;
}

.rplg .cb-review-stars{
  flex:0 0 auto;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:4px;
}

.rplg .cb-review-body{
  margin-top:14px;
  color:#4a4f57;
  font-size:14px;
  line-height:1.6;
}

.rplg .cb-quote{
  color:#7a8796;
}


/* =========================================================
   5) Responsive
   ========================================================= */

@media (max-width: 900px){
  .rplg .rplg-reviews > .rplg-review{
    width:85%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 520px){
  .rplg .rplg-reviews{
    gap:20px;
    padding-left:12px;
    padding-right:12px;
  }

  .rplg .rplg-reviews > .rplg-review{
    width:92%;
  }

  .rplg .cb-arrow{
    width:38px;
    height:38px;
  }

    <style id="ks-header-reviews-style">
        /* =========================================================
           GOOGLE REVIEWS — SOLO #header_reviews
           ========================================================= */
		#header_reviews *{
			text-shadow: none !important;
			font-family: var(--wp--preset--font-family--jost) !important;
		}
		
        #header_reviews .rplg-badge-cnt {
            display: inline-flex !important;
            max-width: 100% !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-badge2 {
            width: min(300px, 100%) !important;
            min-height: 52px !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            padding: 8px 16px 7px 2px !important;

            background: transparent !important;
            border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9) !important;
            border-radius: 6px !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-badge2-border {
            display: none !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-badge2-btn {
            display: flex !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            width: 100% !important;
            min-height: 36px !important;
			background-color: transparent !important;
			padding: 0 !important;
        }

        /* Logo Google + separador verde */
        #header_reviews .rplg-badge-logo {
            display: flex !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            justify-content: flex-start !important;

            flex: 0 0 120px !important;
            width: 120px !important;
            min-width: 120px !important;
            height: 32px !important;

            margin: 0 12px 0 0 !important;
            padding: 0 14px 0 0 !important;

            box-sizing: content-box !important;
        }

        /* Oculta únicamente la G original generada por el plugin */
        #header_reviews .rplg-badge-logo > svg:not(.ks-google-logo-svg) {
            display: none !important;
        }

        /* SVG inline insertado por JS */
        #header_reviews .ks-google-logo-svg {
            display: block !important;
            width: 120px !important;
            max-width: 100% !important;
            height: auto !important;
            flex: 0 0 auto !important;
        }

        /* Oculta "Google Rating" */
        #header_reviews .rplg-badge2-score > div:first-child {
            display: none !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-badge2-score {
            flex: 1 1 auto !important;
            min-width: 0 !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
        }

        /*
         * Resultado:
         * ★★★★★
         * 4.7 | +700 reviews
         */
        #header_reviews .rplg-badge2-score > div:nth-child(2) {
            display: grid !important;
            grid-template-columns: max-content max-content !important;
            grid-template-areas:
                "stars stars"
                "score reviews" !important;

            align-items: center !important;
            column-gap: 5px !important;
            row-gap: 2px !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-biz-rating {
            display: contents !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-stars {
            grid-area: stars !important;
            display: flex !important;
            align-items: center !important;
            gap: 0 !important;
            line-height: 1 !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-stars svg {
            width: 13px !important;
            height: 13px !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-stars use {
            fill: #fbbc04 !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-biz-score {
            grid-area: score !important;
            margin: 0 !important;

            color: #ffffff !important;
            font-size: 14px !important;
            font-weight: 700 !important;
            line-height: 1.1 !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-biz-score::after {
            content: "|" !important;
            margin-left: 5px !important;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85) !important;
            font-weight: 400 !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-biz-based {
            grid-area: reviews !important;
            margin: 0 !important;

            color: #ffffff !important;
            font-size: 14px !important;
            font-weight: 400 !important;
            line-height: 1.1 !important;
            white-space: nowrap !important;
        }

        #header_reviews .rplg-biz-based-text {
            color: inherit !important;
        }

        @media (max-width: 360px) {
            #header_reviews .rplg-badge2 {
                padding-inline: 10px !important;
            }

            #header_reviews .rplg-badge-logo {
                flex-basis: 88px !important;
                width: 88px !important;
                min-width: 88px !important;

                margin-right: 10px !important;
                padding-right: 10px !important;
            }

            #header_reviews .ks-google-logo-svg {
                width: 76px !important;
            }

            #header_reviews .rplg-biz-score,
            #header_reviews .rplg-biz-based {
                font-size: 13px !important;
            }
        }
    </style>

<script id="wp-block-template-skip-link-js-after">
	( function() {
		var skipLinkTarget = document.querySelector( 'main' ),
			sibling,
			skipLinkTargetID,
			skipLink;

		// Early exit if a skip-link target can't be located.
		if ( ! skipLinkTarget ) {
			return;
		}

		/*
		 * Get the site wrapper.
		 * The skip-link will be injected in the beginning of it.
		 */
		sibling = document.querySelector( '.wp-site-blocks' );

		// Early exit if the root element was not found.
		if ( ! sibling ) {
			return;
		}

		// Get the skip-link target's ID, and generate one if it doesn't exist.
		skipLinkTargetID = skipLinkTarget.id;
		if ( ! skipLinkTargetID ) {
			skipLinkTargetID = 'wp--skip-link--target';
			skipLinkTarget.id = skipLinkTargetID;
		}

		// Create the skip link.
		skipLink = document.createElement( 'a' );
		skipLink.classList.add( 'skip-link', 'screen-reader-text' );
		skipLink.id = 'wp-skip-link';
		skipLink.href = '#' + skipLinkTargetID;
		skipLink.innerText = 'Skip to content';

		// Inject the skip link.
		sibling.parentElement.insertBefore( skipLink, sibling );
	}() );

    <script>
      (function(){
        function mobileMenuIsOpen(){
          return !!document.querySelector('.wp-block-navigation__responsive-container.is-menu-open');
        }

        function setOpen(li, open){
          li.classList.toggle('is-submenu-open', open);
          var btn = li.querySelector(':scope > .wp-block-navigation-submenu__toggle');
          if (btn) btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
        }

        document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
          if (!mobileMenuIsOpen()) return;

          var toggleBtn = e.target.closest('.wp-block-navigation-submenu__toggle');
          if (toggleBtn) {
            var li = toggleBtn.closest('li.wp-block-navigation-submenu');
            if (!li) return;

            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();

            var willOpen = !li.classList.contains('is-submenu-open');
            setOpen(li, willOpen);
            return;
          }

          var a = e.target.closest('li.wp-block-navigation-submenu > a.wp-block-navigation-item__content');
          if (!a) return;

          var li = a.closest('li.wp-block-navigation-submenu');
          if (!li) return;

          if (!li.classList.contains('is-submenu-open')) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.stopPropagation();
            setOpen(li, true);
            return;
          }
          // If already open -> allow navigation
        }, true);

        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
          document.querySelectorAll('.wp-block-navigation__responsive-container li.wp-block-navigation-submenu').forEach(function(li){
            var open = li.classList.contains('is-submenu-open');

    <script id="job-form-toggle-js">
    (function(){
        var positionsAvailable = true;
        
        function init() {
            var triggers = document.querySelectorAll('.form_show_trigger');
            var forms = document.querySelectorAll('.job_application_form');
            
            // If no positions available, replace trigger with message
            if (!positionsAvailable) {
                triggers.forEach(function(trigger) {
                    var message = document.createElement('p');
                    message.className = 'no-positions-message';
                    message.textContent = 'Sorry, there are no positions available at this time.';
                    trigger.parentNode.replaceChild(message, trigger);
                });
                
                // Also hide the form
                forms.forEach(function(form) {
                    form.style.display = 'none';
                });
                
                return;
            }
            
            // Normal toggle behavior
            triggers.forEach(function(trigger) {
                trigger.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    
                    forms.forEach(function(form) {
                        form.classList.toggle('is-visible');
                    });
                    
                    // Optional: scroll to form
                    var form = document.querySelector('.job_application_form.is-visible');
                    if (form) {
                        setTimeout(function() {
                            form.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
                        }, 100);
                    }
                });
            });
        }
        
        if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
            document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
        } else {
            init();
        }
    })();
    </script>

    <script id="cf7-custom-scripts">
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        const forms = document.querySelectorAll('.cf7-custom-form');
        
        forms.forEach(function(form) {
            const checkboxField = form.querySelector('.cf7-field--checkbox');
            const checkbox = form.querySelector('.cf7-field--checkbox input[type="checkbox"]');
            const submitField = form.querySelector('.cf7-field--submit');
            const submitBtn = form.querySelector('.cf7-field--submit input[type="submit"]');
            
            if (!checkbox || !checkboxField || !submitField || !submitBtn) return;
            
            // Add message element if not exists
            let messageEl = checkboxField.querySelector('.acceptance-message');
            if (!messageEl) {
                messageEl = document.createElement('span');
                messageEl.className = 'acceptance-message';
                messageEl.textContent = 'Please accept the privacy policy to continue.';
                checkboxField.appendChild(messageEl);
            }
            
            // Create overlay to capture clicks on disabled button
            const overlay = document.createElement('div');
            overlay.className = 'cf7-submit-overlay';
            submitBtn.parentElement.style.position = 'relative';
            submitBtn.parentElement.appendChild(overlay);
            
            // Update overlay visibility based on checkbox state
            function updateOverlay() {
                if (checkbox.checked) {
                    overlay.style.display = 'none';
                } else {
                    overlay.style.display = 'block';
                }
            }
            
            // Initial state
            updateOverlay();
            
            // Show error when clicking overlay
            overlay.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                checkboxField.classList.add('show-error');
                checkbox.focus();
            });
            
            // Hide error and update overlay when checkbox changes
            checkbox.addEventListener('change', function() {
                if (this.checked) {
                    checkboxField.classList.remove('show-error');
                } else {
                    checkboxField.classList.add('show-error');
                }
                updateOverlay();
            });
        });
    });
    </script>

                });

                /*
                 * Based on 735 reviews → +700 reviews
                 * Trunca al centenar inferior, nunca infla el número:
                 * 760 → +700
                 * 799 → +700
                 * 800 → +800
                 */
                container.querySelectorAll('.rplg-biz-based-text').forEach(function (element) {
                    var currentText = element.textContent.trim();

                    if (/^\+\d[\d,]*\s+reviews$/i.test(currentText)) {
                        return;
                    }

                    var match = currentText.match(/(\d[\d.,\s]*)/);

                    if (!match) {
                        return;
                    }

                    var reviews = parseInt(
                        match[1].replace(/[^\d]/g, ''),
                        10
                    );

                    if (!Number.isFinite(reviews)) {
                        return;
                    }

                    var displayedReviews = reviews >= 100
                        ? Math.floor(reviews / 100) * 100
                        : reviews;

                    element.textContent =
                        '+' + displayedReviews.toLocaleString('en-US') + ' reviews';
                });

            function initHeaderReviews() {
                var container = document.getElementById('header_reviews');

                if (!container) {

                 * Reaplica el formato si el plugin vuelve a renderizar
                 * el badge de forma diferida o por AJAX.
                 */
                var isQueued = false;

                var observer = new MutationObserver(function () {
                    if (isQueued) {
                        return;
                    }

                    isQueued = true;

                    window.requestAnimationFrame(function () {
                        decorateHeaderReviews();
                        isQueued = false;
                    });
                });

                observer.observe(container, {
                    childList: true,
                    subtree: true,
                    characterData: true
                });
            }

            if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
                document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initHeaderReviews);
            } else {
                initHeaderReviews();
            }
